text_block_list.text:
The first day of the year sets the tone
for what
follows, so Мэдзиро Райан and I
visit the shrine
together to start off right.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Okay, Trainer. I'm gonna pray with all
I've got! It's
my senior year, and hustle is
muscle!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Well, since I'm gonna be a senior, I
thought it was
a good time to get hyped
up!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
When I took on the Arima Kinen at the
end of last
year...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
It felt like my senior year would be this
huge
ocean.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
If I don't stay strong, the current will
hold me
back. But I know what to do!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
The first shrine visit of the year is really

important! I need to set a clear goal for
myself
here.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
It seems like Ryan's becoming more
resolute as
she heads into the new year
with great ambition.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
There are lots of ways to set firm goals...
And I
wanna do something about my
personal life too.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
What I'm saying is... don't be afraid to
be strict
with me! If I'm gonna
accomplish my goals, then
my heart
needs training too!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: A strict goal? In that case...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
D-do I really have to go that far right
from the
start?!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: Romance, my number one weakness...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Okay, then my first challenge for the
new year is
to watch a romantic movie to
the end without
closing my eyes in
embarrassment!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
And with that, we end up going to the
movie
theater.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
(I-it's finally beginning... Oh my gosh...
I'm so
nervous! ♪)
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
(Oh no, I can't keep watching... I'll just
close my
eyes for a little bit...)
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
I need to tell you something. Listen... I
really like
you.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Let's race until that furlong marker!
Running
clockwise is your specialty after
all.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: Hehehe... ♪ Zzz... Zzz...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: My deepest desire? ...You're right, I really don't have a proper goal to work for right now.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
I'm done with the Classics, and I even
raced
against McQueen, so I need
something to move
on to.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Trainer, could you give me the
day to
think about this?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: That evening...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, Trainer... I just can't decide.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
There's so much to choose from. There
are a lot
of important races, and then
there's McQueen
and Oguri...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Can we put if off until later? Right now, I
can't
help but want to go after all of
them.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан
choice_data_list:
Going for everything will be pretty difficult, you
know?

text_block_list.text:
I'm set on trying though! No matter how
hard it
gets, I'll prepare myself for the
worst!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Whichever dream I chase, I'll do it with
all my
muscles—and heart!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Revolutionize them? Now that's a tough
one. Not
just train my muscles, but
totally reinvent them...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Right, I've always focused on
strengthening my
muscles, but I need to
do more...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: Okay, I got it!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: Let's play basketball! Come on!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
I'll try moving my body differently than
usual. Do
some pivots, work on my
layups... That should get
things off to a
good start!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
She's dozed off with her mouth wide
open... Well,
some sleep should
reenergize her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She's prepared for anything that may
come, so I
can see her making progress
in any direction.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро Райан moves around lightly on her
feet. It
seems she's getting a lot of ideas
from playing
basketball.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
